question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the italicised segment in the given sentence.

Tin is easy to *shape* in any desired form.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"malleable"** means capable of being shaped or bent or drawn out; easily influenced. (आकार देने योग्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The artist found the metal to be highly **malleable** and perfect for sculpting.
 
 
 
• **"Rigid"** refers to something that is stiff and does not bend easily. (कठोर)
 
 
• **Example: **The **rigid** structure of the bridge made it very strong.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the word** "malleable"** correctly describes something that is easy to shape in any desired form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rigid** (कठोर): Stiff and not flexible.

 
 
• **Example:** The** rigid** rules of the institution were hard to follow.
 
 
 
• **Immutable** (अपरिवर्तनीय): Unchanging over time or unable to be changed.
 
 
• **Example: **The laws of physics are considered** immutable.**
 
 
 
• **Gullible** (भोला): Easily persuaded to believe something; credulous.
 
 
• **Example:** The **gullible** tourist believed every word the street vendor said.
 
 

 

3d:Tbae,

The correct answer is Option 3)</st
